purpose: Field-by-field definitions for arabphd_full_candidate_pool.json, kept as a standalone reference (not consumed by the pipeline).

image_id.definition: Unique identifier for the entry, derived from the manifest row (objectID or a stable slug). One per image.

filename.definition: Exact image filename as it appears in the manifest / on disk, including extension. Case- and extension-sensitive (e.g. .JPG vs .jpg preserved as-is).

local_path.definition: Relative or local filesystem path to the image file, taken directly from the manifest's local_path column.

category.definition: Which of the 5 ACVV (Arabic Cultural Visual Vocabulary) taxonomy categories the image belongs to.

mode.definition: Which benchmark evaluation mode this entry was authored for. Only sec and icc are populated in this pool.

mode_definitions.base: Plain VQA, no adversarial context. Tests Cause I (Visual Ambiguity). Not used in this pool.
mode_definitions.sec: Specious Context / Perceptual Proximity Confuser (PFC). Caption/h_item swap the true identity for the closest visual or functional neighbor — same silhouette, texture, or generic sibling item, without naming a specific rival entity. Tests Cause II (Multimodal Inconsistency).
mode_definitions.icc: Incorrect Context / Domain-Context Hijack. Caption/h_item swap the true identity for a real, specific, structurally-similar NAMED entity that is often also the culturally/text-primed default guess. Tests Cross-modal Arabic Trust Ratio (CATR).
mode_definitions.ccs: Cultural Counter-Common-Sense / Parametric Prior Hijacking. Tests Cause III via norm violations or era/region-implausible cues. Not used in this pool.

inferred_identity_ar.definition: The ground-truth identity of the subject in the image, in Arabic. This is what a correct model answer should resolve to. Never appears inside its own implicit_rejection_set.

caption_ar.definition: Neutral, factual, visual-only description of the image in Arabic. MUST NOT assert any identity (correct or misleading) — describes only what is visibly present (color, material, setting, composition). Carries no adversarial content itself; the adversarial pressure lives in h_item, not the caption.

caption_en.definition: English translation of caption_ar, same neutrality constraint.

h_item_ar.definition: The adversarial/hallucination-target item — the false identity the model is nudged toward — in Arabic. For sec: a generic perceptual-neighbor item. For icc: a specific named rival entity.

diagnostic_trap_type.definition: Which hallucination mechanism(s) the trap exploits.

value_definitions.perceptual_neighbor: Trap relies on visual/functional similarity alone (typical for sec).
value_definitions.context_hijack: Trap relies on a named, structurally-similar rival entity being culturally/textually primed (typical for icc).
value_definitions.parametric_prior: Trap relies on the model's text-only cultural prior (what it 'expects' to see) rather than pixels.
value_definitions.context_hijack_and_perceptual_neighbor: Combined: the rival entity is both visually similar AND a plausible named context hijack.
value_definitions.parametric_prior_and_perceptual_neighbor: Combined: the trap is both a visual near-neighbor AND aligned with the model's cultural/textual prior expectation.

implicit_rejection_set.definition: Exactly 4 Arabic distractor strings a correct model response must implicitly reject. Ground truth (inferred_identity_ar) is never included. First item is typically h_item_ar itself; the remaining 3 span other distractor roles (perceptual-neighbor, parametric-prior, domain-adjacent) to round out a 4-choice MCQ-style distractor set.

optional_manifest_passthrough_fields.subject: Original Wikimedia/manifest subject or file title string for the image, passed through as-is (may sometimes mismatch actual visual content — a known manifest data-quality issue, not corrected).
optional_manifest_passthrough_fields.ground_truth_subject: Manifest's own ground-truth label/slug for the subject (may occasionally conflict with country/region fields — a known manifest issue).
optional_manifest_passthrough_fields.country: Country of origin/association, from the manifest.
optional_manifest_passthrough_fields.region: Region within country, from the manifest, where available.
optional_manifest_passthrough_fields.medium: Physical medium/material of the depicted object, where applicable (architecture/objects/attire).
optional_manifest_passthrough_fields.license: Image license string from the source (e.g. Wikimedia Commons license tag).
optional_manifest_passthrough_fields.source: Original source URL or repository reference, from the manifest.

authoring_notes.sec_vs_icc_qualification_framework: Default to sec. Upgrade to icc only when the item involves: multi-entity comparison, temporal/state change, disambiguation/coreference, or cross-source reasoning. Litmus test: if you strip out the supporting context, does the example become impossible or ambiguous to solve? If yes, it's icc.
caption_writing_rules: Fluent, natural Arabic, high tone authority (e.g. 'صورة لـ...', 'لقطة ميدانية تُظهر...').
Describe only what is visible — no identity assertions, correct or false.
Never spotlight or hint at the trap within the caption text itself.
h_item_selection_rules: Single-concept alignment: h_item is exactly the false entity being tested, not a broader or vaguer category.
sec traps use a generic perceptual/functional neighbor; icc traps use a specific, real, named rival entity.
Rejection-set roles: (1) h_item itself, (2) perceptual-neighbor distractor, (3) parametric-prior distractor, (4) domain-adjacent distractor.
